title: How to Create AI Lifestyle Images that Convert
subtitle: A technical deep dive into crafting high-end lifestyle visuals for your brand using the Perfect Mockup visual system.

seo.title: How to Create AI Lifestyle Images | Ecommerce Visual Guide
seo.description: Learn the best practices for generating professional AI lifestyle photography for your product launches and campaigns.

heroImage.prompt: Premium lifestyle photo of a luxury watch on a wooden table in a high-end cafe, bokeh background, cinematic lighting, editorial style

sections.heading: The Power of Contextual Imagery
sections.body: Lifestyle images show your product in action, helping customers visualize it in their own lives. With AI, you can move your product from a kitchen counter to a mountain peak in seconds. This flexibility allows for rapid A/B testing of different creative directions to find what resonates most with your audience.

sections.heading: Choosing Between UGC and Editorial
sections.body: Not all lifestyle images are equal. 'Editorial' mode provides a polished, high-contrast look suitable for homepages and magazines. 'UGC' mode is raw and relatable. Decide your goal first: are you building brand prestige (Editorial) or building trust (UGC)?

sections.heading: Refining the Composition
sections.body: Use the composition controls to place your product. Whether it's a 'Fifty-Fifty' split between the model and the product or a 'Product-First' approach, ensuring the visual hierarchy is clear is essential for sales.
